digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and quiet-window reclaim
propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of pack bytes in the tickets-store history must be reclaimed via length-aware git fast-export filter fast-import strip followed by repack and gc.
The filtered tickets pack size is marginally over the 128 MiB CI gate threshold, causing stale-base changes to fail verification; proactive repack/gc is needed to add headroom.
Bug ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must be repaired (rebar fsck zero-diagnostic state achieved) before history rewrite to ensure the authoritative store is clean before repacking.

Identity verification post-rewrite is failing: compacted ledger entries retain non-null pre-rewrite commit_sha values, causing key-not-valid-at-era count discrepancy (949→5613) that blocks history rewrite until resolved.
Off-repo bundles must be created, verified, and retained at both pre-repair and post-repair states to enable safe rollback in a second quiet window if required.
Exact force-with-lease publication with leaf-ref ancestry verification and incremental size-pack growth <1 MB validation is required before writer resumption.
